picks.title: Esther and Anne Wojcicki back new healthcare accelerator, fund
picks.why_it_matters: A new AI Health Fund and Treehub accelerator from proven operators signals fresh capital and co-investment opportunities at the intersection of healthcare and AI—a sector seeing sustained founder and investor interest.

picks.title: AI is spitting out more potential drugs than ever. This startup wants to figure out which ones matter.
picks.why_it_matters: 10x Science's $4.8M seed round highlights a growing infrastructure opportunity: as AI-generated drug candidates explode, startups that help pharma validate and prioritize molecules become critical enabling layers.

picks.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
picks.why_it_matters: A flagship-quality coding model at 27B parameters lowers the compute barrier for startups building AI-native dev tools, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape for code-generation applications.
